content: सिद्धिः {%f.%} [सिध्-क्तिन्] .²1 Accomplishment, fulfilment, completion, perfection, complete attainment (of an object); विरोधि सिद्धेरिति कर्तुमुद्यतः <ls>Ki. 14. 8</ls>; क्रियासिद्धिः सत्त्वे भवति महतां नोपकरणे <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²2 Success, prosperity, welfare, well-being. .²3 Establishment, settlement. .²4 Substantiation, demonstration, proof, indisputable conclusion. .²5 Validity (of a rule, law <ab>&c.</ab>). .²6 Decision, adjudication, settlement (of a law-suit); कार्यकारणसिद्धौ च प्रसन्ना बुद्धिरव्यया <ls>Rām. 4. 18. 47</ls>; तस्मान्न लेखसामर्थ्यात् सिद्धिरैकान्तिकी मता <ls>Śukra. 4. 726</ls>. .²7 Certainty, truth, accuracy, correctness. .²8 Payment, liquidation (of a debt); अधमर्णार्थसिद्धपर्थमुत्तमर्णेन चोदितः <ls>Ms. 8. 47</ls>. .²9 Preparing, cooking (as of drugs <ab>&c.</ab>). .²10 The solution of a problem. .²11 Readiness. .²12 Complete purity or sanctification. .²13 A superhuman power or faculty; (these faculties are eight:-- अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यं महिमा तथा . ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च तथा कामावसायिता ..). .²14 The acquisition of supernatural powers by magical means. .²15 Marvellous skill or capability. .²16 Good effect or result. .²17 Final beatitude, final emancipation. .²18 Understanding, intellect. .²19 Concealment, vanishing, making oneself invisible. .²20 A magical shoe (supposed to convey the wearer wherever he likes). .²21 A kind of Yoga. .²22 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²23 Complete knowledge. .²24 Advantage, use, good effect. .²25 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva ({%m.%} in this sense). .²26 Efficacy, efficiency. .²27 Becoming intelligible (as sounds or words). .²28 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) The pointing out in the same person of various good qualities.
